cd /tmp/tmp.q7oKnWaBuO && python - <<'EOF'
import glob, zipfile
for v in ["9.6.23","9.7.0","9.7.1","9.7.2","9.7.3","9.7.4","9.7.5","9.7.6","9.7.7"]:
    whl = glob.glob(f"v{v}/*.whl")
    if not whl:
        print(v, "NO WHEEL"); continue
    z = zipfile.ZipFile(whl[0])
    data = z.read("material/templates/__init__.py").decode()
    print(v, "banner" if "MkDocs 2.0" in data else "no banner")
EOF
